title: Law to make it easier to sign up for Fair Fares
summary: This bill would require the Social Services Commissioner to create a streamlined enrollment process for Fair Fares NYC, letting eligible New Yorkers consent to use their SNAP or cash assistance application information to enroll. It would also require the city to notify eligible people about this process, try to reach agreements with state agencies to identify more eligible residents, study automatic enrollment in all city benefit programs, and report annually to the Council on enrollment and usage.
